# Al-Rahma Academy

> Al-Rahma Academy teaches the Holy Quran, Arabic and Islamic studies online through one-to-one live lessons with certified Al-Azhar tutors, for children and adults across Europe and worldwide. One free 60-minute trial lesson, flexible scheduling, female tutors available.

Canonical domain: https://al-rahmaacademy.com
Complete list of published pages: https://al-rahmaacademy.com/sitemap.xml (this file is a short, hand-picked guide; the sitemap is the exhaustive list and the source of truth for which pages exist).

## Published languages
The site is published and indexable in four languages. Each non-English language has its own landing page and URL prefix.
- [Home](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/): Overview of courses, pricing and the free trial. English is the default language.
- [Arabic / العربية](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/ar/): Arabic landing page, right-to-left (تعلم القرآن الكريم أونلاين).
- [French / Français](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/fr/): French landing page (Apprendre le Coran en ligne).
- [Italian / Italiano](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/it/): Italian landing page (Impara il Corano online).

Other interface languages are not published for search and are not listed here. A few pages are published only in French and Italian (the enrollment page and some tools); they are listed under those languages below.

## Main pages (English)
- [About](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/academy/about): Mission, vision and values of the academy.
- [Teachers](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/academy/teachers): Certified Al-Azhar tutors and their specialties.
- [FAQ](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/resources/faq): Answers about lessons, pricing, trials and certificates.

## Courses (English)
- [Courses Hub](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/courses): All available courses.
- [Quran & Tajweed](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/courses/quran): Quran reading, Tajweed and Hifz programme.
- [Arabic](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/courses/arabic): Arabic alphabet course: the Arabic letters with audio pronunciation and exercises.
- [Ijazah Certification](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/courses/ijazah): Quran memorization and recitation with a connected chain (sanad).
- [Islamic Studies](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/courses/islamic-studies): Aqeedah, Fiqh, Seerah, Hadith and Tafsir.

## Islamic tools (English)
- [Tools Hub](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/tools): Free Islamic tools.
- [Prayer & Islamic Tools](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/tools/prayer): Prayer times, Qibla compass, Islamic calendar and Verse of the Day.
- [Adhkar & Du'a Library](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/tools/adhkar): Daily remembrances and supplications.
- [Tajweed Checker](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/tools/tajweed-checker): AI Tajweed Checker for recitation practice.
- [Tasbeeh Counter](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/tools/tasbeeh): Digital tasbeeh counter.
- [Arabic Alphabet](https://al-rahmaacademy.com/tools/arabic-alphabet): Learn the Arabic letters.

## Source and content notes
- Arabic Quran text, translations, tafsir and recitation audio shown in the Quran tools are served live by external providers (for example the Quran.com API and alquran.cloud); the academy does not author them.
- The hadith library loads its collections from a public open-source hadith dataset; the Arabic text is the classical original and the English text is a translation.
- Tools are learning aids. They are not fatwas and do not replace a qualified teacher.
